newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto looks well, starts official schedule.
newsitem.headline: Suharto looks well, starts official schedule.

text.p: Indonesia's President Suharto looked in good health when he started his official duties on Thursday with a speech to local officials, an eyewitness said.
"He looks fine. He's reading out his speech," the eyewitness said.

Palace sources denied rumours on foreign exchange markets that hit the rupiah overnight that the 75-year-old president was ill. Sources close to the presidency said he had suffered from a cold earlier in the week.
The rupiah stabilised in early Jakarta trading at 2,401.75/02.25 at 0220 GMT from an overnight low in New York of 2,414.00.
